# PC MAX

> PC MAX is a Windows gaming optimization platform — per-game graphics settings and Windows tuning delivered from its own server, not baked into the app. It installs per-game frame-generation workflows (OptiScaler, AI Optical Flow, Streamline PC MAX) and applies safe, fully reversible Windows tuning — snapshotted before every change, with zero telemetry in the desktop app.

PC MAX is a desktop application for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) built by the PC MAX team. It sits between a player's game catalogue, their GPU and Windows itself: games and optimization profiles sync from the server (nothing is hardcoded — new titles arrive without an app rebuild), the Rust engine tunes the operating system for gaming workloads, and it installs the right frame-generation workflow for each game. Every change is snapshotted before it happens, applied as an all-or-nothing transaction, and reversible in one click. The core edition is free, works offline once synced, and contains no telemetry.

Key facts:

- Product name: PC MAX (a brand of the PC MAX team)
- Price: Free core edition. A free account (email + password) signs you in and syncs your catalogue; premium extras are subscription-gated and enforced server-side (Pro edition coming soon)
- Platforms: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit (x64)
- Size: 220 MB on disk
- Requirements: 4 GB RAM minimum (8 GB recommended), DirectX 12 compatible GPU
- Offline-first: works from your last synced catalogue and profiles, re-syncs automatically when back online; internet only for the first sync, updates and optional package downloads
- Privacy: zero telemetry in the desktop app (no analytics, no trackers); the website logs anonymous aggregate events only
- Safety model: snapshot → apply (one transaction, all or nothing) → rollback on failure → restore (one-click, anytime). 235 automated tests in CI (151 API · 48 desktop · 36 Rust engine)
- Languages: English at the root URL, Persian (فارسی, RTL) at /fa — both fully translated documents
- Official website: https://cianetir.github.io/pc-max-web
- Download: https://github.com/CiaNetIR/pc-max/releases/latest (always the newest stable release; the website's download button resolves it live from GitHub)
- Support email: support@pcmax.io
- Community: https://discord.gg/pcmax

The complete, citation-ready reference (full FAQ in English and Persian, workflows, installation steps, benchmarks methodology, privacy and terms) is available at:

- [llms-full.txt](https://cianetir.github.io/pc-max-web/llms-full.txt): Complete PC MAX product reference for LLMs and answer engines
